scholarships.title: Fu Jen Catholic University Scholarship for New International Students (Doctoral Degree Programs)

existing.description: Fu Jen Catholic University's International Student Admissions Office publishes a set of Fu Jen-funded scholarships for newly admitted international students. For doctoral degree programmes the university states that the scholarship runs for eight consecutive semesters from the semester of admission, that tuition and miscellaneous fees are waived or reduced as part of the award, and that the holder receives a stipend of NT$50,000 per semester paid out in monthly instalments of NT$10,000. The scholarship is requested inside the admission application itself rather than through a separate form. Applications for Spring 2027 are open until 14 October 2026, and the first round for Fall 2027 opens on 15 October 2026.
eligibility: Must be a new international student applying for admission to a Fu Jen Catholic University degree programme
Must request the scholarship when applying for admission in the Fu Jen Catholic University international student online application system
For doctoral programmes the award runs for eight consecutive semesters from the semester in which the recipient is admitted
Must complete registration for the semester before the scholarship begins
The university states that the scholarship terms are subject to change and that the admission brochure for the relevant semester is authoritative
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to new international students applying for admission to a degree programme at Fu Jen Catholic University who tick the scholarship when submitting the online admission application. The award is decided as part of admission, so admission is a precondition.
benefits: Tuition and miscellaneous fee waiver or reduction for doctoral degree programmes
Stipend of NT$50,000 per semester for doctoral degree programmes
Stipend paid in monthly instalments of NT$10,000 after registration for the semester
Award runs for eight consecutive semesters for doctoral degree programmes

For undergraduate and Master's entrants the university publishes separate tiers: new students enrolled from AY 115 onwards receive NT$10,000 for the semester of admission, paid as a single payment at the end of the semester, while those enrolled in AY 114 or earlier received NT$10,000, NT$30,000 or NT$50,000 per semester over four consecutive semesters
coverage: Tuition and miscellaneous fees waived or reduced as part of the doctoral scholarship
Eight consecutive semesters of support for doctoral degree programmes
requirements: Apply for admission through the Fu Jen Catholic University international student online application system during a published application period
Request the scholarship during the online admission application, because the university states the scholarship is applied for when applying for admission

Pay the application fee and upload the remittance receipt inside the application system during the application period (NT$1,600 per application for domestic remittance, USD 65 for overseas remittance; the fee is non-refundable)
Complete registration for the semester in order for the scholarship to begin
For doctoral programmes, satisfy the admission requirements of the doctoral programme applied for
documents: Completed Fu Jen Catholic University international student online admission application with the scholarship requested
Application fee remittance receipt uploaded through the application system, using the remittance details downloaded from that same system
Documents required for admission to the chosen department, as listed on the International Student Admissions Office 'Required Documents' page and in the admission brochure for that semester
application_method: Check that the department you want is open to international students for that academic year
Apply online through the Fu Jen Catholic University international student application system at http://idsasys.oie.fju.edu.tw/
Select the scholarship as part of the admission application
Download the dedicated remittance details from the system, pay the application fee and upload the receipt during the application period
Paper submissions are not accepted - the university states that only online application with document upload is handled
If admitted, confirm the intent to enrol by the published deadline and complete registration for the semester
existing.selection_notes: The university states that the scholarship is applied for at the time of admission application and that the admission brochure for the relevant semester is the accurate source, because the scholarship terms are subject to change. No separate selection committee, interview or ranking for the scholarship is described on the page read; funding follows the admission decision. Tuition and miscellaneous fees are described as 'waived or reduced', so the exact fee treatment should be confirmed against the admission brochure for the semester applied for.
existing.best_fit: New international applicants to a Fu Jen Catholic University doctoral degree programme, and to its undergraduate and Master's programmes, who apply inside the published admission window and can pay the application fee.
existing.notes: The same official page also lists a 'Love for Ukraine Scholarship Program', worth NT$150,000 per semester, limited to eight semesters for undergraduate programmes, four for Master's and six for doctoral programmes, paid monthly over the five months after registration. That programme is a separate award and is not the subject of this record. Fu Jen also runs a separate government-scholarship page for applicants who apply through Taiwan's government scholarship schemes.
existing.duration: Eight consecutive semesters for doctoral degree programmes, beginning in the semester of admission; for undergraduate and Master's programmes the university publishes different, shorter terms (see notes)
existing.application_period: Open now for Spring 2027 (online application and document submission 14 September 2026 13:00 to 14 October 2026 23:59; application review or entrance exams 15 October to 2 November 2026; admission results announced 23 November 2026; accepted applicants must confirm their intent to enrol by 30 November 2026; certificates of admission mailed 11 December 2026; check-in and registration February 2027). The Fall 2027 first round opens on 15 October 2026 at 13:00 and closes on 4 December 2026 at 23:59, with review from 5 to 21 December 2026 and results on 8 January 2027; a Fall 2027 second round runs 1 March 2027 13:00 to 15 May 2027 23:59 with results on 9 July 2027.
existing.deadline_display: Spring 2027 international student applications: online application and document submission from 14 September 2026 13:00 to 14 October 2026 23:59. Fall 2027 first round: 15 October 2026 13:00 to 4 December 2026 23:59.
